entries.title: 1. The Persona Deep-Dive (Character Creation)
entries.base_prompt: [Base Archetype: e.g., The Visionary, The Rebel, The Sage] + [Contradiction/Quirk: To add human depth] + [Visual Anchor: Key physical/style trait] + [Vocal Identity: Tone and vocabulary style] + [Core Motivation: What drives them?]

metadata.use_case: Initial creation of a brand ambassador or influencer persona.

entries.title: 2. The Dialogue Simulator (Testing Verbal Identity)
entries.base_prompt: [Persona Context: Reference the Deep-Dive profile] + [Stimulus: A user comment/situation] + [Constraint: "Respond using only [Specific Vocabulary]" or "Maintain [Tone]"] + [Goal: Achieve [Specific Emotional Outcome]"

metadata.use_case: Testing how an archetype would respond to specific social media comments or customer inquiries.

entries.title: 3. The Archetype Stress Test (Scenario Expansion)
entries.base_prompt: [Archetype Profile] + [New Environment/Format: e.g., A high-stakes business negotiation, a casual coffee shop chat] + [Conflict: An unexpected challenge] + [Requirement: Describe their reaction and the resulting dialogue]

metadata.use_case: Expanding the character's world and ensuring they don't become one-dimensional in new content formats.
